Cannot recommend enough. So friendly and skilled, cared very much about his work. Very comfortable and chill vibe. Excellent price for the work of an artist.
I'm sure anyone who rated less than 5 stars is someone you would not want as a customer.

Went to get my beard trimmed and cleaned up and the super friendly barber always made sure its the length I wanted and the height of the trim line was okay and not too low etc. before cutting too far. Small shop and I only had to wait at …

Love the place when I first walked in. The barber has great taste in music, so you can enjoy some tunes while you sit and wait (there were 2 other people before me). Friendly guy, great environment and most importantly a great hair cut for a reasonable amount. If I need another hair cut before leaving Chiang Mai, I will go back!

Very nice barber with a lot of experience, the place doesn’t look fancy but on places like this is strongly recommended to not judge the book by his cover. The barber can speak English and i really like his style, highly recommended for everyone who wants a fresh cut🙏 …

I had a great experience. I showed up and there was no wait or line, and my haircut was fast. Barber had a wonderful welcoming aura and nice personality. I showed him a picture for reference, and together we got my desired style. I am very pleased ! 😍 …
I went in for a full head and face shave. He did a fantastic job and finished it off with a face and neck massage. If I lived here, I’d probably go there every week.

I am sorry. Wish I could say nice things. But I also must be honest.
I am bold. I went to shave my head and my beard. The head was ok. But the face was awful.  The man didn't use hot towels. Almost no shavingcream so the shaving …

This guy made me smile! Great cut and great taste in music. He has a really friendly way and a truly relaxing personality.
Really enjoyed the stay at his shop and
can recommend a visit 10/10.

Does not listen to a word you say. Showed him a photo and explained what haircut I wanted (0.5 on the sides low fade and a trim on the top) but decided to do his own thing, shaved the whole back and sides a number 1, cut my fringe so …

An amazing experience. This is an open-style barber shop where you can walk in anytime, sometimes there’s a short wait, but I was able to sit down straight away. You can immediately tell he takes a lot of care with every single cut and …
Absolutely vibing barber, and an excellent haircut with absolute precision
Friendly service, great result.
Great barbershop! Great barber! Great haircut! Great music!

Very meticulous , chill guy, best haircut in a long time.
I needed a coffee so I came back so basically no wait at all.
It's a unique experience! The barber cuts the hair very nice!
Not satisfied
Open is a solid barber. I would recommend anyone looking for a haircut to check out his shop.
Great Job Sir

Avoid….just hacked away at my hair going to short and when I said to short he just stopped cutting the to so now I have half an haircut. Wouldn’t recommend at all and expensive for Thailand at 350 baht

Delightful!
10/10 ❤️
I showed a picture of what I wanted and I got exactly what I showed. Very nice and great singer. I would come back

I asked for a clean shave; I got the full service and a nice neck/head massage as well.

The barber is very gentle and friendly and hummed along with the oldies he was listening to
Excellent service with music playing. Head and beard shaved, plus a little massage. Great job! Thank you for everything.
Perfect. Good music. Fast and good. Friendly. Professional
Perfect haircut! Also, amazing singer!!!

Excellent barber/hairdresser who cuts with scissors 🙌🙌🙌🙌

Thanks man for your work, and as soon as I'm back in Chiang Mai I'll definitely come back to listen to the music you play in your salon 😉

I had my hair cut here again when I visited Chiang Mai. This was my third time. The cheerful owner remembered me and I was very happy. I was satisfied with how well my hair looked this time too. I highly recommend it.
Perfect.
Had a brilliant hair cut here! Barber is absolutely maticulous ensuring a great shape to the cut.  Some great old school tracks on in the background too.
Friendly and talented. Comfortable and cool facility
I'm an easy customer ( almost bold, lol). The barber is friendly, quick, reasonably priced and speaks English. He did a great job trimming my facial hair.

Whatever you ask, he does it.

The short relaxing massage at the end was five stars, I almost fell asleep.

I recommend it, you can go!!!
Greaaaat barber! Thank you! Greetings from Croatia!
I really liked the haircut, also he was very polite and attentive. 10/10
Easily the most meticulous barber I’ve ever visited. Spotless execution and not a single stray hair left behind. Highly recommended
Very skilled barber. One of the best. I asked for a zero fade and trim. They took time and care to do a great job. Even align the sides properly. Highly recommend
Fast, high-quality, with a song and a smile!
Sorry guys, cannot recommened this place.. the razor was not sharp, and a price wayyy too expensive..

This is my second year in Chiang Mai. He loves his job, and this tiny place exudes a positive vibe. The owner is a friendly guy who enjoys singing while he works with his customers. Highly recommended!
Amazing work with both the hair and the beard! Great attention to details.

Great, precise haircut, shave, quiet barbershop, my favorite 50's and 60's music was playing in the background, which the barber perfectly complemented with his singing. 💈 very positive atmosphere 👍 …

In short: perfect. I decided at the last minute (haircut and beard shave). A few Google reviews convinced me. And I'm thrilled. Plus, there's excellent music and the owner is very friendly. Go for it!!
Great haircut, great service, great music. Highly recommendable.
Highly recommended. I’m always really satisfied every time I get my hair cut here. There’s also parking available, which is great.
